notes.notes: ADDED: Daily Reward. Claim 100 XP coins every 24 hours. Run the game then claim them from the main menu. The timer will tell you when you can claim the next reward.

notes.title: UPDATE 14 SEP 2023 - Fixed The Payment Confirmation Screen in Shop
notes.notes: A minor fix to correct the payment confirmation screen not showing when making a purchase from the shop. All purchases have been stored correctly and there was no data loss, only the confirmation screen screen display needed fixing because it was not showing correctly.

notes.title: UPDATE 14 SEP 2023 - minor engine updates and upgrades
notes.notes: A few minor engine updates and fixes to keep everything up to date with the latest versions. These updates will not change gameplay or any features of the game.

notes.title: UPDATE 10 SEP 2023 - New Team Spawn Voices, Spawn Area Fixes and Some UI Changes
notes.notes:
ADDED: Voice for deploying with team name.
FIXED: Old Market Town: Changed some spawn point areas to stop spawning into walls and cover objects.
CHANGED: UI Changes: The join team buttons on the before and after game screens are now easier to read.
CHANGED: UI changes: Ammo remaining and health indicators are now the same height. The health indicator bar is now thicker.

notes.title: UPDATE 06 SEP 2023 - Loadout Screen Changes and Some Out-of-bounds Alert Fixes
notes.notes:
UPDATED: The minimap will show your team as green arrows on the map and the enemy as red. The enemy positions will show when they fire a weapon.
CHANGED: The loadout screen now shows larger weapons. The man holding the weapons was removed.
FIXED: The Factory: Some more out-of-bounds areas now have kill zones to prevent roof hopping.
FIXED: Loadout names are now showing correctly on the selection screen.

notes.title: Update 01 SEP 2023 - New Camos with Free Versions for Pistol P-01 Added
notes.notes:
FIXED: Some weapon camos did not show correctly on some weapons
FIXED: Some UI improvements have been made to the buy coins screen in the shop
UPDATED: Premium weapon camos are now free to use on the P-01 pistol and you can buy the camo to use on other weapons
ADDED: New weapon camo Golden Spark added with a free version to use on the P-01 pistol
ADDED: New weapon camo Purple Spark added with a free version to use on the P-01 pistol
ADDED: New weapon camo Blue Spark added with a free version to use on the P-01 pistol

PREMIUM CAMO PURCHASE AND TRIAL INFORMATION

Premium camos are now free to use on Pistol P-01 which is the free weapon issued to all players in the game. You can purchase each camo to use it on other weapons.

notes.title: Update 25 Aug 2023 - Seize and Occupy (SAO) Game Mode & Some Map Optimisation
notes.notes:
ADDED: A new multiplayer game mode called Seize and Occupy. Your team must seize different locations around the map and occupy them. Each occupied location wins points needed to bring your team to victory.
UPDATED: Generated new lighting on all maps to accommodate for the changes made during the last few updates
UPDATED: Old Market Town optimisation to make some scenery items load faster
FIXED: Extra kill zones added to all maps to prevent roof hopping and jumping over choke points
